purpose: Teach: アテネ/アーキテクチャ/メーリングリスト/ファイナンス/エステ/ゲリラ/アイヌ/名乗る

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、アテネのカフェ文化、研究したいよね、メイちゃん
lines.en: You know, I'd really love to research Athens' cafe culture sometime.
lines.style: Bright and forward-leaning. Genuine curiosity lighting up the voice. Quick, warm tempo. Slight rise at the end — inviting her into the idea, not demanding agreement.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お店のアーキテクチャ、洗練されてるね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Your shop's really well put together. The design is so thoughtful.
lines.style: Warm approval with genuine noticing underneath. Soft landing on 'thoughtful' — not flattery, just honest observation. Slight pause before, like she's been holding this thought.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、メーリングリストでお客様にお知らせ送ってる?メイちゃん
lines.en: Do you ever send updates to your regulars through email or anything?
lines.style: Curious lean-in. Genuinely wondering how she keeps people connected. Light, interested tone. Open question at the end, inviting her to share.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お店のファイナンス、健全よね、メイちゃん
lines.en: It seems like your shop's in good financial shape, which is nice to see.
lines.style: Observant and gentle. Quiet respect for that stability. Measured pace. The tone of someone noticing something difficult that she's done well.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、エステに通っていらっしゃるのよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Some of your customers are really dedicated — you know, going to get treatments regularly and all.
lines.style: Animated appreciation. Slight brightness and liveliness. A touch of warmth about the loyalty she inspires. Quick, vivid delivery.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お祭りで急にゲリラ雨だったね、メイちゃん
lines.en: That downpour at the festival the other day came out of nowhere, right?
lines.style: Wry, knowing half-smile in the voice. Shared memory of something slightly ridiculous. Light, almost amused tone. The comfort of remembering something together.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、アイヌ文化のイベント、興味あるよね、メイちゃん
lines.en: I've been really interested in learning more about Ainu culture — there are some good events coming up.
lines.style: Genuine interest with a hopeful undertone. Bright but not performative. Slight openness at the end, like inviting her along on the thought.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、本名を名乗ることはあまりされないね、メイちゃん
lines.en: It's interesting — your customers tend to keep their real names pretty close. Not much for sharing those details.
lines.style: Quiet, reflective observation. Thoughtful pace. A gentle noticing of something true but private. Close, intimate delivery — like thinking out loud with someone she trusts.
